      tags: [email]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Communication list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  communications:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        id:
                          type: string
                          format: uuid
                        type:
                          type: string
                          enum: [email, note, meeting]
                        subject:
                          type: string
                        from:
                          type: string
                        to:
                          type: array
                          items:
                            type: string
                        body:
                          type: string
                        thread_id:
                          type: string
                        attachments:
                          type: array
                          items:
                            type: string
                            format: uuid
                        created_at:
                          type: string
                          format: date-time

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Components
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
components:
  parameters:
    DealId:
      name: dealId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
    PageLimit:
      name: limit
      in: query
      schema:
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
        maximum: 100
        default: 50
    PageCursor:
      name: cursor
      in: query
      schema:
        type: string

  responses:
    ValidationError:
      description: Validation error
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiError"
    NotFoundError:
      description: Resource not found
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiError"

  schemas:
    # ── Stages ──
    Stage:
      type: string
      enum: [broker, origination, underwriting, closing, monitoring]

    OriginationOutcome:
      type: string
      enum: [reject, need_info, proceed, refer]

    # ── Deal ──
    Deal:
      type: object
      required: [id, tenant_id, borrower_name, stage, created_at, updated_at]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        tenant_id:
          type: string
        borrower_name:
          type: string
        borrower_registration_number:
          type: string
        jurisdiction:
          type: string
        requested_amount:
          type: integer
          description: Minor units
        purpose:
          type: string
        stage:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Stage"
        origination_outcome:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/OriginationOutcome"
        assigned_to:
          type: string
        primary_entity_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        custom_fields:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        updated_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    CreateDealRequest:
      type: object
      required: [borrower_name]
      properties:
        borrower_name:
          type: string
        jurisdiction:
          type: string
        requested_amount:
          type: integer
        purpose:
          type: string
        borrower_registration_number:
          type: string
        assigned_to:
          type: string
        custom_fields:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true

    UpdateDealRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        borrower_name:
          type: string
        jurisdiction:
          type: string
        requested_amount:
          type: integer
        purpose:
          type: string
        borrower_registration_number:
          type: string
        assigned_to:
          type: string
        origination_outcome:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/OriginationOutcome"
        custom_fields:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true

    DealList:
      type: object
      required: [deals, total]
      properties:
        deals:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Deal"
        total:
          type: integer
        cursor:
          type: string

    # ── Stage Transition ──
    StageTransitionRequest:
      type: object
      required: [to_stage]
      properties:
        to_stage:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Stage"
        rationale:
          type: string
        override:
          type: boolean
          default: false
        override_rationale:
          type: string

    StageTransition:
      type: object
      required: [id, deal_id, from_stage, to_stage, actor, transitioned_at]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        deal_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        from_stage:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Stage"
        to_stage:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Stage"
        actor:
          type: string
        rationale:
          type: string
        override:
          type: boolean
        override_rationale:
          type: string
        checklist_snapshot:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              item:
                type: string
              satisfied:
                type: boolean
        transitioned_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    # ── Document ──
    Document:
      type: object
      required: [id, deal_id, doc_type, filename, created_at]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        deal_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        doc_type:
          type: string
        phase:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Stage"
        filename:
          type: string
        label:
          type: string
        mime_type:
          type: string
        size_bytes:
          type: integer
        checksum:
          type: string
        version:
          type: integer
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        created_by:
          type: string

    CreateDocumentRequest:
      type: object
      required: [doc_type, filename, content_base64]
      properties:
        doc_type:
          type: string
        phase:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Stage"
        filename:
          type: string
        label:
          type: string
        content_base64:
          type: string
          format: byte

    # ── Audit Event ──
    AuditEvent:
      type: object
      required: [id, deal_id, type, actor, timestamp]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        deal_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        type:
          type: string
          description: "e.g. DEAL_CREATED, DEAL_UPDATED, STAGE_TRANSITION, DOCUMENT_UPLOADED"
        actor:
          type: string
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        object_type:
          type: string
        object_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        changes:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              field:
                type: string
              before:
                {}
              after:
                {}
        metadata:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true

    # ── Entity ──
    Entity:
      type: object
      required: [id, type, name, created_at]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [company, person]
        name:
          type: string
        legal_name:
          type: string
        registration_number:
          type: string
        lei:
          type: string
        jurisdiction:
          type: string
        identifiers:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              scheme:
                type: string
              value:
                type: string
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        updated_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    CreateEntityRequest:
      type: object
      required: [type, name]
      properties:
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [company, person]
        name:
          type: string
        legal_name:
          type: string
        registration_number:
          type: string
        lei:
          type: string
        jurisdiction:
          type: string
        identifiers:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            required: [scheme, value]
            properties:
              scheme:
                type: string
              value:
                type: string

    UpdateEntityRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
        legal_name:
          type: string
        registration_number:
          type: string
        lei:
          type: string
        jurisdiction:
          type: string

    # ── Relationship ──
    Relationship:
      type: object
      required: [id, from_entity_id, to_entity_id, type, created_at]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        from_entity_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        to_entity_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [owns, guarantees, directs]
        ownership_pct:
          type: number
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 100
        metadata:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    CreateRelationshipRequest:
      type: object
      required: [from_entity_id, to_entity_id, type]
      properties:
        from_entity_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        to_entity_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [owns, guarantees, directs]
        ownership_pct:
          type: number
        metadata:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true

    # ── Template ──
    Template:
      type: object
      required: [id, name, phase, doc_type, version]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
        name:
          type: string
        phase:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Stage"
        doc_type:
          type: string
        version:
          type: string
        frontmatter:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true
        body:
          type: string
          description: Markdown template body with mustache variables

    # ── Covenant ──
    Covenant:
      type: object
      required: [id, deal_id, name, type, metric, operator, threshold]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        deal_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        name:
          type: string
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [financial, reporting, information]
        metric:
          type: string
          description: "e.g. dscr, leverage, min_liquidity, gross_margin"
        operator:
          type: string
          enum: [">=", "<=", ">", "<", "=="]
        threshold:
          type: number
        frequency:
          type: string
          enum: [monthly, quarterly, annually]
        grace_period_days:
          type: integer
          default: 0
        notes:
          type: string
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    CreateCovenantRequest:
      type: object
      required: [name, type, metric, operator, threshold]
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [financial, reporting, information]
        metric:
          type: string
        operator:
          type: string
          enum: [">=", "<=", ">", "<", "=="]
        threshold:
          type: number
        frequency:
          type: string
          enum: [monthly, quarterly, annually]
        grace_period_days:
          type: integer
        notes:
          type: string

    CovenantTestResult:
      type: object
      required: [covenant_id, status, actual_value, threshold, tested_at]
      properties:
        covenant_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        covenant_name:
          type: string
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [pass, fail, warning, grace_period, waived]
        actual_value:
          type: number
        threshold:
          type: number
        operator:
          type: string
        metric:
          type: string
        tested_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        grace_period_expires:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    # ── Evaluate (Underwriting) ──
    EvaluateRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        policy:
          type: object
          description: Lender policy configuration for the evaluation
          required: [policy_id, model]
          properties:
            policy_id:
              type: string
            model:
              type: string
              description: LLM model identifier
            persona:
              type: string
            target_yield_pct:
              type: number
            max_single_loan:
              type: number
            total_capital:
              type: number
            sector_limits:
              type: object
              additionalProperties:
                type: number
            params:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: true
        provider:
          type: string
          enum: [openrouter, anthropic]
          description: Reserved for future full-agent provider selection
        mode:
          type: string
          enum: [full, rules_only]
          default: full
          description: "full = LLM agent evaluation; rules_only = deterministic rules (thin agent fallback)"
        allow_rules_fallback:
          type: boolean
          default: false
          description: "Only when mode=full: if true, allows deterministic rules fallback when LLM is unavailable or fails"

    EvaluateResponse:
      type: object
      description: Structured UnderwritingRun result conforming to underwriting-run.schema.json
      required: [run_id, decision]
      properties:
        run_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        decision:
          type: object
          required: [action]
          properties:
            action:
              type: string
              enum: [approve, decline, counter, refer]
            terms:
              type: object
              properties:
                amount:
                  type: number
                apr:
                  type: number
                  description: "Decimal (0.095 = 9.5%)"
                tenor_months:
                  type: integer
            risk_grade:
              type: string
            confidence:
              type: number
        rationale:
          type: object
          properties:
            summary:
              type: string
            key_factors:
              type: array
              items:
                type: string
            what_would_change:
              type: array
              items:
                type: string
        trace:
          type: object
          properties:
            steps:
              type: array
              items:
                type: object
            latency_ms:
              type: integer
            cost:
              type: object
              properties:
                tokens_in:
                  type: integer
                tokens_out:
                  type: integer
                estimated_cost_usd:
                  type: number

    # ── Error ──
    ApiError:
      type: object
      required: [error]
      properties:
        error:
          type: object
          required: [code, message]
          properties:
            code:
              type: string
            message:
              type: string
            details:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: true
            retryable:
              type: boolean
              default: false
